description.en: The Doubao Work cloud agent as a model provider: each request runs as one new work task on a cloud computer, over the desktop app's own web session. Sign in with the Doubao QR (or paste the doubao.com cookie block); text, reasoning and the client's tools — asked for as text — come back as an OpenAI chat stream.
description.zh: 把豆包工作的云端智能体当模型用：每个请求是云电脑上的一个新工作任务，直接走桌面 App 自己的网页会话协议。用豆包 App 扫码登录（或粘贴 doubao.com 的 Cookie），回复的正文、思考过程和以文本调用的客户端工具都以 OpenAI 聊天流返回。

description.en: A Doubao login QR appears — scan it with the Doubao mobile app and the cloud-agent models unlock on this machine's gateway. Hosts without a window fall back to pasting the Cookie header of a signed-in doubao.com tab.
description.zh: 页面会显示豆包登录二维码，用手机上的豆包 App 扫码即可解锁云端智能体模型。无窗口的主机可退回粘贴已登录 doubao.com 标签页的 Cookie。
